## Current role

Senior Software Engineer at Rooster HR (Singapore), since June 2025. Previously
Software Engineer there (Feb 2024 - June 2025) and Associate Software Engineer
(March 2023 - Feb 2024).

Owns backend domains across a 20+ service platform — core, user, billing, payroll,
time-tracking and analytics services — from schema design through production
support. Drives architecture decisions for cross-service work including shared
schema contracts and event-driven processing. Ships to production on Kubernetes
(EKS) via ArgoCD GitOps. Runs backend code review and mentors junior engineers.
